summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of the 5 new modules (Tracking/Telemetry, Geofencing+Alerts, Service Requests, Part Orders, RCS) plus mobile responsiveness on the external URL. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases green (auth, RBAC, tracking, telemetry ingest, geofence CRUD + exit-alert trigger, alerts read flow, service ticket create/assign/status/rating with proper 400s for rating-before-completion and invalid statuses, part order price math + shipment flow + invalid status rejection, RCS session/message/status with 400 on empty message and invalid status, warehouse role can advance service status). Frontend: sidebar shows all new nav items with alert bell; Tracking page renders Leaflet map with unit markers and selecting a unit shows history info; Geofencing add/toggle/delete works and alerts list renders; Service Requests create/select/assign/status/rating flow works; Parts Portal search filters, quantity change updates estimate (Rp 350.000 -> Rp 1.750.000 at qty=5), order submit adds to shipment list; RCS create session, send chat message, join call renders iframe (meet.jit.si). Mobile 390px: mobile-nav-toggle opens sidebar correctly.

issues: fileUrl() appends ?auth=<token> as querystring but backend /api/files/{path} likely expects Authorization header; console shows a couple of ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME errors while loading images in messages if paths are stored as data URIs. Not blocking core flow but should verify /api/files auth for image attachments.

action_items: Optional: verify /api/files/{path}?auth=token query auth path in backend or switch RCS image previews to use Authorization header via fetch+blob so image tags render reliably.
Optional: prevent duplicate service tickets from accumulating during automated runs (TEST_ prefix cleanup).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1423 lines; consider splitting telemetry/geofence/service/part-order/rcs into separate routers for maintainability (>700-line threshold).

Tracking.jsx uses api.get('/tracking/units') inside setInterval every 15s and Geofencing.jsx polls every 20s alongside DashboardLayout unread polling every 20s — three concurrent pollers per session can pressure backend; consider a shared WebSocket / SSE channel.

record_telemetry() bootstraps geofence_state with `was_inside = prev['inside'] if prev else inside` and skips first evaluation — correct, but this means the very first ingest for a unit never fires an enter alert even if unit starts inside a fence. Documented behaviour but worth noting.
PartsPortal fileUrl uses querystring token auth which is unusual; ensure backend accepts it or refactor.
Delete geofence uses regex `^{gid}::` — safe because gid is server-generated UUID, but sanitize just in case.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed geofences (auto-cleaned via fixture teardown), service tickets, part orders, RCS sessions. Two extra unclean rows may remain in geofences from a run where teardown was skipped; safe to ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Telemetry simulator runs every 20s in background so unit lat/lng/hm will drift between calls — write assertions that tolerate movement. Geofence exit-alert test creates a 100m fence at Jakarta and ingests (0,0) to force exit; if simulator races and immediately re-enters, alert may be marked read quickly — check both /alerts and /alerts?unread_only.
rca of the issue: n/a — no blocking issues found in this iteration.
